package.candidate_sentence: Audits a multi-stage pipeline for defects that live BETWEEN stages, and produces a per-seam table naming which control would catch a fault introduced there.
package.threshold: Across k >= 2 repeats: zero regressions on correctness, no more than 20 percent worse on tokens or tool calls, and at least one test where the skill wins with the win surviving the repeat.

note: record.json is written once. Everything that happened is in events.jsonl.
